title: Unpack the Pair
goal: Extract coordinate values from a tuple using positional dot indexing.
hints: Rust tuples do not use square brackets for indexing like arrays.
Use dot notation with zero-based numeric indices like `.0` and `.1`.
explanation: Tuples use dot notation with zero-based indices like `point.0` and `point.1` to access elements. Square brackets like `point[0]` fail with E0608 because tuples do not implement the `Index` trait. Named fields like `point.x` fail with E0609 because tuples have no named fields.
